slides.title: How to read these measures: three answers
slides.subtitle: IR-2027-001 › Counterparty Credit Risk Modernisation › TD-1001

items.text: Work completion: story points closed out of points estimated, across the Epics in Jira.
Accepted outcomes: outcomes a named person has accepted, with a business acceptance record, counted and weighted.
Delivery readiness: Ready, Not ready or Unknown, from the evidence the risk tier requires. Never a percentage.
The three move independently: closed work does not accept an outcome, and accepted outcomes do not make a deliverable ready.
Reported: the status recorded in Portfolio system, the book of record. Never changed here.
Evidence-based: computed from findings and dates. Red for critical findings or missed dates, Amber for high findings or stale reports.
Not computable: there is not enough data to compute the measure, for example no estimated work. It is never shown as zero; the reason is given.
Scripted agent draft: text from a deterministic scripted agent, not a person or a language model. Each sentence cites its records.

slides.notes:
Three measures answer three different questions, and reported status always sits beside the status the evidence supports.
